title: Clara Cat and the Lost Yarn
description: A playful kitten learns to clean up her toys after losing her favorite ball of yarn.
character_reference: a fluffy white kitten with soft grey tabby patches and bright turquoise eyes

scenes.narration: Clara had the bounceiest ball of purple yarn in the whole house, but she left it hiding somewhere.
scenes.visual: puzzled sitting posture in messy playroom, scratching behind fluffy ear with hind paw, looking around with confused wide turquoise eyes

scenes.narration: She searched under the sofa pillows, but found only dusty old blocks and a stray feather.
scenes.visual: peering head first underneath a cozy living room sofa, twitching whiskers, dusty floorboards, soft indoor lighting

scenes.narration: Next, she checked behind the rocking chair. Still no purple ball to be seen anywhere.
scenes.visual: walking dejectedly past wooden chair legs, drooping tail with a curved tip, searching expression, warm domestic interior

scenes.narration: Realizing her room was far too messy, Clara decided to tidy up every single toy she owned.
scenes.visual: determined facial expression, pushing toy blocks into a wooden basket with paws, active playful posture on a soft rug

scenes.narration: As she rolled away a stack of pillows, a bright flash of purple appeared in the corner.
scenes.visual: eyes widening in sudden joyful surprise, reaching out one paw toward a corner behind a cushion, cozy bedroom setting

scenes.narration: There was her favorite yarn, resting safely right where she had accidentally kicked it earlier.
scenes.visual: happily hugging a round ball of purple yarn against chest, closed-eye joyful smile, soft warm indoor lighting

scenes.narration: Clara learned that keeping things neat makes finding your favorite treasures so much easier.
scenes.visual: sitting proudly beside a perfectly organized toy basket, contented expression, clean tidy rug background

scenes.narration: A tidy space brings peace of mind. Follow along for more bedtime stories.
scenes.visual: waving one paw gently toward camera, sleepy relaxed expression, soft evening lamplight casting cozy shadows
